purpose: AI-native business operating system that enables founders and operators to run one or more companies through unified organizational structure, role-based dashboards, workflows/SOPs, agentic execution, strategic intelligence, memory/knowledge systems, governance/approvals, and cross-platform integration with CreatorOS and LYFEOS.
target_users: Primary: Solo founders and owner-operators running one or more companies
Future: Enterprise teams, AI-first solo operators
product_promise: EntrepreneurOS is the AI-assisted company command center — a cognitive operating system for business execution that lets founders run multiple businesses from anywhere in a few focused hours per day.
vision_statement: To build the world's first truly AI-native operating system for entrepreneurs: a platform that structures companies, guides founders, deploys agentic labor, manages workflows, learns continuously, and helps humans operate at a world-class level regardless of prior experience.

screens.name: Auth / Entry
screens.description: Sign in, create or access workspace

screens.name: Company Setup
screens.description: Define company name, type, stage, offer, target customer, core goals

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.description: Company summary, KPI strip, today panel (priorities, next-best action, upcoming workflow steps), AI copilot panel, operating memory/notes

screens.name: Department/Role Management
screens.description: Create departments, roles, responsibilities with linked workflows/tasks/docs

screens.name: Workflow Run View
screens.description: Execute workflow — step through, mark complete, generate AI assistance at steps, store notes/results

screens.name: Task Board/List
screens.description: Create tasks, assign to roles, link to workflows, update status, priority, due dates

screens.name: AI Copilot Workspace
screens.description: Ask business questions, get summaries, draft workflows/SOPs/plans/documents, receive next-best action suggestions

screens.name: Docs/Notes Workspace
screens.description: SOP notes, role notes, operating notes, strategy notes

workflows: Set up business operating system (create workspace, define company, get AI-generated org structure)
See what matters today (home dashboard, KPIs, alerts, next-best actions, active workflows)
Store and run workflows/SOPs (create or AI-generate, step through with AI)
Use AI to plan and draft work (plans, documents, role definitions, workflow drafts, summaries)
Track tasks and priorities (create/assign tasks, link to workflows, status dashboard)
Keep business context persistent (memory stores company context, workflow context, preferences)
Review key metrics and next-best actions (KPI cards, AI recommendations, portfolio views)
feature_list: Portfolio multi-company management with cross-company metrics
AI-generated org charts based on business model and stage
First-class role objects with human/AI ownership
Universal dashboard with Header, AI Control Panel, Left Rail, Workspace, Right Rail
Workflow engine with approval gates, retries, checkpoints, branching
Reusable skill system with versioning and trust scoring
Role-specific agent runtime with planner, skill router, tool executor
Centralized AI Gateway with model routing and cost-aware selection
Hybrid RBAC+ABAC governance with autonomy levels
Resilience: retries, circuit breakers, saga compensation, failover
Cross-platform integration with CreatorOS and LyfeOS
Strategic command center with KPIs and next-best actions
ai_agent_concepts: AI copilot (mentor + operator + chief of staff)
umh_integration_assumptions: EOS is one projection built on UMH substrate
Substrate provides: identity, memory, knowledge graph, skills, workflows, AI gateway, governance, observability
EOS registers with UMH at runtime via abstract ports
Strict layer separation: substrate/ never imports from transports/ or services/
Current cc_sdk (Opus 4.6 via subscription) → Gemini 2.5 Flash → Groq → Ollama fallback chain

auth_assumptions.end_state: Hybrid RBAC+ABAC+policy-based with org/resource/execution authority layers
auth_assumptions.status: EOS uses Clerk; OS Platform Standard v1 Firebase recommendation is STALE

deployment_assumptions.status: deferred — no production deployment yet for SaaS layer

database_assumptions.current: Neon Postgres with RLS scoped by org_id, Drizzle ORM

acceptance_criteria_candidates: Founder can create one company workspace
Founder can define a basic org structure (departments, roles, responsibilities)
Founder can create or AI-generate workflows
Founder can run workflows with AI assistance at each step
Founder can manage tasks from one dashboard
Founder can ask AI for useful, context-aware help
Founder can return later and see retained meaningful context
End-state: manage multiple businesses from one portfolio view
End-state: generate and evolve org structures automatically
End-state: execute workflows manually, hybrid, or autonomously
End-state: route work through agents and skills reliably
End-state: integrate with CreatorOS and LYFEOS through shared intelligence substrate

mvp_definition.scope: AI-assisted company command center for one founder and one business
releases: R5: Docs+Memory (notes, operating docs, persistent context)

prd_quality.strengths: Comprehensive WHAT, novel universal business primitive taxonomy, well-scoped MVP with clear non-goals
prd_quality.weaknesses: No wireframes, no API contracts, no UI component specs, aspirational vision mixed with current-system audits, pricing absent, competitive analysis absent
